- Option B (split across two days): Wed 4/20, 6:00–6:45 PM PDT orientation; Thu 4/21, 6:30–8:00 PM PDT hands-on + routing/load test.

What we need from your side to make the load test productive:
- Confirm which participants will join each session (SME names + engineering lead).
- Provide the sample prompt set (or we can use the prompts you sent earlier; attach a sanitized CSV below if you want).
- For sandbox access: either a temporary token (expiring) or permission for our runner IP range; acct-ops, can you advise which is easiest?

I'm attaching: POC_runbook_v3.pdf (includes a short checklist), a sample-prompts.csv stub, and I can send a calendar invite once you pick Option A or B. We'll set automatic reminders 24h + 1h before sessions.

If it helps, I'll loop in Rishi to prepare a cost/minor-quantization variant and Marissa to manage the load test plan.

—Vanessa
